{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the number of loyal customers and number of conversions
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
n_converted = loyal_df['converted'].sum()

# Compute the conversion fraction
conversion_fraction = n_converted / n_loyal

# Print all required values
print(f"Number of loyal customers: {n_loyal}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal customers: {n_converted}")
print(f"Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}")"}
